links.outcome: Multimodal LLM sensitivity for DR detection, referable DR, DR staging, and maculopathy on local hospital fundus images
links.effect: GPT-4 sensitivity 82% for DR and 80% for referable DR, meeting UK NICE criteria; all LLMs performed poorly in DR staging and diabetic maculopathy detection.
links.quote: However, all LLMs, including GPT-4, performed poorly in staging DR and detecting diabetic maculopathy.

screen.reason: Retrospective external validation benchmark of multimodal LLMs (GPT-4, Gemini 1.5, Claude 3 Haiku, Mistral Large) on 228 fundus images to diagnose and stage diabetic retinopathy against ophthalmologist ground truth.
